tooltip.specialpickaxes.controls: Use key: activate • Sneak: precise mining / magnet off
message.specialpickaxes.anchor_set: Anchor set. Use again after cooldown to return.
message.specialpickaxes.anchor_blocked: Return blocked, out of range or in another dimension.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.overdrive: Right-click: a brief mining burst up to 10×. Costs durability.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.excavator: Mine a 3×3 plane. Sneak to mine a single block.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.vein_miner: Mine connected ores of the same type, within server limits.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.inferno: Smelts valid drops using furnace recipes. Silk Touch takes priority.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.magnetic: Attracts nearby available items in sight. Sneak to disable.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.scanner: Right-click: a limited local ore scan; shows nearest relative coordinates.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.storm: Right-click: shock and slow a limited number of visible monsters.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.void: Right-click: set/return to a temporary anchor. Sneak-use clears it. Cannot cross walls.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.ender: Right-click: short blink along your view, stopping before obstacles.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.explosive: Right-click a block: bounded mining blast. No fire or entity damage.
